description: SDK link login: the card shows the link (and a one-time code), cancel/timeout/exit end it, nothing stays open or leaks

flows.name: cancel
flows.script:
print("Open https://example.test/auth?x=1 to sign in", flush=True)
import time; time.sleep(30)

flows.name: authorized-by-exit
timeout
flows.script:
print("Open https://example.test/auth?x=1 to sign in", flush=True)
import time; time.sleep(30)

flows.name: process-fails
flows.script:
print("Open https://example.test/auth?x=1 to sign in", flush=True)
import sys; print('Login failed: denied'); sys.exit(3)

expect.result: error: 登录没有成功：Login failed: denied

flows.name: paste-good
flows.script:
print("Open https://example.test/auth?x=1 to sign in", flush=True)
import sys
line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
sys.exit(0 if line == 'good' else 1)

flows.name: paste-bad
flows.script:
print("Open https://example.test/auth?x=1 to sign in", flush=True)
import sys
line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
sys.exit(0 if line == 'good' else 1)
